mapper.insert: insert into rabbit_departure_records (house_id, rabbit_id, cage_id, departure_type, departure_date, reason, remark, request_id, create_by, update_by, operator_name) values (#{houseId}, #{rabbitId}, #{cageId}, #{departureType}, #{departureDate}, #{reason}, #{remark}, #{requestId}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{operatorName})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, rabbit_id, cage_id, departure_type, departure_date, reason, remark, request_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, operator_name, update_time from rabbit_departure_records where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
